summary: Aura Minerals filed a Form 6-K attaching a November 5, 2026 press release announcing a regular quarterly cash dividend of US$0.72 per common share, approximately US$60.4 million in aggregate, with a Record Date of November 18, 2026 and payment on November 27, 2026. Brazilian Depositary Receipt holders receive US$0.24 per BDR (three BDRs per share) around December 8, 2026 in Brazilian Reais. The payment exceeds the minimum 20%-of-Adjusted-EBITDA distribution under the dividend policy; CEO Rodrigo Barbosa cited a roughly 4% trailing dividend and buyback yield. Watch for FX-driven BDR payout variation and cadence of future shareholder returns.
